item.title: WRE News: Miami Tops 2025 Rankings as America’s Best Winter Escape
item.description: Miami, FL - January 7, 2025 - Miami just claimed the crown as America’s ultimate winter escape, offering sunshine, warmth, and culture when much of the country is bundled up in gray.
